This is plausible behavior degradation introduced by the diff; the browser default at the time may have sent referers, but the strict fallback-free check is verifiable in the diff. Confidence moderate as the practical impact depends on client behavior.

judged_text: Referer-based gating breaks for referer-suppressing clients — browsers/privacy settings/referrerpolicy that omit the Referer fail the host check and get 403 forever with no fallback, so the embed silently never loads for those users

record.issue_text: Referer-based gating breaks for referer-suppressing clients — browsers/privacy settings/referrerpolicy that omit the Referer fail the host check and get 403 forever with no fallback, so the embed silently never loads for those users

adjudication.rationale: `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` hard-requires a matching `request.referer` host: `raise ... if URI(request.referer || '').host != SiteSetting.embeddable_host`. If the browser/client omits the Referer header (privacy settings / referrerpolicy / some proxies), `request.referer` is nil, `URI('')` has `host == nil`, and the request is always rejected with InvalidAccess. There is no fallback to validate via the required `embed_url` param (even though `best` does `params.require(:embed_url)`), so the embed can never load for those clients.
